definitions.explanation: a type of brown sea vegetable commonly used in Japanese cuisine, known for its dark color and rich mineral content

examples.japanese: ひじき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
ひじき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鉄分|てつぶん}→鉄分：19444_tetsubun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧ひじき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戻|もど}して→戻す：02317_modosu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{調理|ちょうり}する→調理する：26793_chourisuru⟧。
examples.english: Rehydrate the dried hijiki in water before cooking.

notes:
ひじき is a nutritious seaweed (brown algae) that is a staple in traditional Japanese cooking.

WRITING:
- Can be written as {鹿尾菜|ひじき} or {羊栖菜|ひじき}, but usually written in hiragana

PREPARATION:
- Sold dried (⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧ひじき)
- Must be rehydrated (⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧) before use
- Expands significantly when soaked

COMMON DISHES:
- ひじき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧ (simmered hijiki with vegetables)
- ひじきご{飯|はん} (hijiki rice)
- ひじき⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧ (hijiki salad)

NUTRITION:
- Rich in ⟦{鉄分|てつぶん}→鉄分：19444_tetsubun⟧ (iron), ⟦{食物|しょくもつ}{繊維|せんい}→食物繊維：15118_shokumotsuseni⟧ (fiber)
- Often served in school lunches for nutrition

TYPES:
- {芽|め}ひじき (small leaves)
- {長|なが}ひじき (long stems)

RELATED SEAWEEDS:
- ⟦わかめ→わかめ：10654_wakame⟧ (wakame)
- ⟦{昆布|こんぶ}→昆布：04934_konbu⟧ (kelp)
- ⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧ (nori)
